semiconductor_relevance: High — Qnity Electronics provides critical materials and solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including CMP pads and photoresists for advanced-node fabrication.
summary: Qnity Electronics is a key supplier of advanced materials for semiconductor manufacturing, offering solutions such as CMP pads and photoresists for precision patterning in high-end memory and logic devices. Their product portfolio also includes sealing parts and materials for PCBs, addressing the needs of advanced chip designs and AI applications.
capabilities: Photoresists for 193 nm and 193 immersion lithography
Laminates and adhesive systems for PCBs
